chapters.title: QUIET
chapters.text: No squeeze and ADX 18: price swings around its mean, the setting where the reversion play looks for a stretch to the band.

chapters.title: REVERSION SHORT
chapters.text: No squeeze on and ADX 17, under 30. RSI 72 as price reaches the upper band, and the bar closes back inside at 26,505.25: REVERSION SHORT. Target the mean 26,486.00, stop 26,524.50.

chapters.title: HIT THE MEAN
chapters.text: Price reaches the mean 26,492.00, 13 pts from the setup close (the rail follows the EMA), before the 1R stop: HIT THE MEAN, and the rail comes off.

note: REVERSION SHORT reward 13.25 (1.4 ATR) risk 19.25 heat 0.50 bars 9
